name: The Fortress
objective: Krampus Keep is the first proper Team Krampus dungeon: frozen corridors, prison cells, laboratories, ancient ruins, storage rooms, and battle chambers. Fight through to the central chamber.
intro: The fortress is carved into the mountain itself. Something older than Team Krampus sleeps beneath its foundations.
dialogue: Krampus Senior Grunt: "Beyond this door is the Director. Turn back."
Krampus Senior Grunt (defeated): "So be it. Face him, then. If you can."
